title: How to choose the best commercial electronic scales?
description: Electronic scales, indispensable today both in the business environment and for personal purposes, have appeared since antiquity. Over time, scales have evolved from simple scales, such as those used in barter, to modern electronic scales capable of complex operations that are becoming indispensable for most businesses.
content:
Today's weighing equipment is widely used for both business and domestic purposes. To date, scales have evolved from simple scales to electronic scales capable of performing complex computational operations, becoming necessary and indispensable for most sales companies. Applications for electronic weighing scales include various industries involved in the precise dosing of certain substances, in retail markets, local kitchens, laboratories, and pharmacies, as well as in stores. Any activity related to sales requires weighing equipment.

Recommendations for the purchase of electronic scales:

For the purchase of a weighing complex that is interconnected with fiscal equipment and other systems, choosing the right equipment can be very difficult. In this sense, it is recommended to seek the opinion of a specialist in the field, and RTI representatives can be helpful, in coming up with useful recommendations on the selection of electronic scales in accordance with the specifics of your business. Every business is unique and requires customized services, products, and equipment. For this reason, manufacturers of electronic scales consider many aspects and factors when creating these products. Anyone should know that there are 4 accuracy classes that electronic scales and scales fall into:

Class I or special class - offers a high level of accuracy in absolutely any measurement.

Class II or high class also guarantees measurement accuracy, especially on high-precision industrial scales.

Class III or middle class - actually refers to scales used for commercial purposes.

Class IV or simple - represented by scales used at the household level, for everyday use.

In addition to these classes into which balances are classified, special attention should be paid to their typology, i.e. the functions and protections they have. It is well known that the weighing of some substances implies the absence of any external factors that could affect the results obtained. In addition, saving results, higher or lower resolution, and other parameters are of great importance for the correct choice of scale. Depending on the type of electronic scale can be:

Simple commercial electronic scales are common scales used in small shops, with a smaller weight capacity.

Trade electronic scales with marking - usually used in supermarkets, equipped with a bar and a display on which all products are displayed. Issue vouchers after weighing, keeping in mind the prices of the goods.

Trade electronic scales with a platform - are recommended for weighing products, especially for wholesalers, with a large capacity.

To choose the right scale for your business, consider the following questions:

Why do we need electronic scales?

When purchasing a scale, analyze what it will be used for and what will need to be weighed. Will you use it for supermarket fresh produce, bulk candy, meat, or other items such as letters or packages? Are most weighed products heavy or light? Large or small? Determine the types of items to be weighed and use them as a starting point.

How accurate do scales need to be?

Fixed accuracy confirms to the buyer that he receives precisely the amount paid, and to the seller - the correct value. All countries have institutions that regulate and strive to maintain sufficient accuracy of scales used in commercial activities. You must ensure that the weighing equipment complies with legal requirements.

What is the maximum amount to be weighed?

I mean, if you own a candy store, will anyone ever buy 250 kg right away? This seems unlikely, so you may want to look for a scale with a smaller weight capacity. If instead, you run a butcher shop where large cuts of meat need to be weighed or a courier company, then a scale with a large capacity is indicated.

How durable should they be?

Choose a scale depending on the environment in which the action takes place. If you use a scale to weigh a lot of food, choose a scale that is easy to clean. Also consider if there are sudden changes in temperature, vibration, interference from other nearby devices, or drafts that could affect accuracy.

Where will they be installed?

Locate the scale carefully, because it cannot be moved once installed. Think easy access to connect, calibrate and use. Daily used scales require frequent calibration to maintain their accuracy and meet the requirements of the competent authorities. Business managers who trade by weight need accurate scales to protect their clients and business. If you want a new scale, carefully evaluate the cost performance, good accuracy, where and by whom the adjustment will be made, and how often it will be calibrated. The better you understand the requirements of the business and the options available, the better choice you will make so you can offer excellent customer service and manage inventory in milligrams, even less.

Finally, we recommend that before purchasing a scale, think about its functions and properties that meet the needs of your business, and if you have difficulty choosing the desired product, it is advisable to seek advice from RTI specialists. In addition to quality products, our company advises you to purchase the right scales, depending on the type of your business.

title: Retail automation: solutions for any type of store
content:
Retail automation includes a set of activities related to the installation of specialized equipment and the introduction of software products in order to increase the efficiency of a trading enterprise. All these problems can be solved and kept under control with the help of complex business automation.

The mpact of trade automation:

The loyalty of all customers will increase significantly by increasing the speed and quality of service. Attract more customers by introducing discount systems, bonus programs, and other loyalty systems.

It will become very easy and convenient to monitor the movement of goods, and constantly monitor turnover. Inventory will be carried out more often and faster. It will be easy to check the available stocks, and product balances and replenish the assortment in time.

Efficient work with suppliers: unique document flow mechanisms for settlements, an automated system for generating orders, and monitoring the status and results of orders.

Business process management will become much easier. You will be able to use many opportunities for sales analysis, such as:

orders to suppliers;

title: Useful tips for choosing a CRM system for retail
content:
Management systems allow you to automate business processes, facilitating the control, planning and forecasting of routine activities within the company. The article aims to both present the problem of choosing an electronic control system and analyze its main functionality.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM) is a customer relationship management system that collects and organizes personal data according to certain criteria. The main purpose of CRM is to form a process of communication with the company's customers, taking into account their needs and wishes through personalized offers and recommendations. Due to the impact of the CRM program on business, today the development of CRM systems has become a separate industry. Many technology companies are developing platforms to help companies manage customer relationships and, as a result, increase revenue. That is why the CRM system is associated with the word "technology".

Business growth improves the CRM tool, which should provide managers with all the information they need, and an easy way for salespeople and marketing managers to track performance. All this information must be combined into one, providing the continuous information needed to make the right decisions.

CRM reads and processes all user data that is stored in the software compartment under the personal identifier of each client. An example of such data could be the following information:

  • Name, age, gender
  • Addresses and contact details
  • Order and payment history
  • Client site navigation data

The information obtained as a result of interaction with the customer is used to form recommendations that meet his needs, as well as to automate the company's work processes. The CRM system facilitates the activities of managers at each stage of the transaction: processes documentation, reminds them of the need to call back or issue an invoice, and displays information about the company in the form of comprehensive reports. The system itself includes tools (databases, statistics, reports, communication channels) that help the company manage customer relationships in a systematic and organized manner.

title: A secure store is a profitable store
description: Securing the store against theft means the synergy between the vigilance of the human factor and the technical safety devices.
content:
Securing the store against theft means the synergy between the vigilance of the human factor and the technical safety devices.

The first thing to start with is to train employees to be more careful and to recognize potential criminals.

Usually, thieves have a rather specific behavior, looking more around the commercial space and the people in the store and less about certain products. If you have noticed a suspicious person, discreetly alert colleagues and accompany this suspicious person as long as he is in the store. You can ask, if everything is in order if he found the product you are looking for, and if you can help with anything, thus strengthening the presence of the staff. In this sense, you must have the necessary staff to serve the customers and supervise the store.

Also, don't forget to greet all customers who enter the store and interact with them. Next to the good image of the store, let the buyers know your presence. By giving him clues that he has been identified, create conditions to avoid crime. On most criminals, an approach like "Can I help you with something?" or "Can I help you find what you're looking for?" it will cause them to abandon their plans.

Buyers with bad intentions try to attract the cashier's attention while another person leaves the store with the stolen goods.

In this sense, make sure that the staff is accessible to all buyers, and never leave the store unattended.

In large stores, labels are often replaced.

In this sense, the cashier must look at the price of each product, and if he notices something wrong, he can turn to the help of colleagues. No matter how vigilant your staff may be, it is virtually impossible to eliminate store theft by relying solely on management techniques. In this sense, combine management with anti-theft systems and video surveillance. In medium "open space" stores, employees cannot track every customer, so installing a video surveillance system is useful to insure you in case of crimes, because the recorded documentation can be presented as evidence.

The anti-theft system helps retailers increase sales, in order to expose more expensive products to visible places.

The most effective way to prevent crime, especially shoplifting, is to equip the sales area as well as the storerooms with an anti-theft system consisting of a video surveillance system and anti-theft gates. The latter is used to detect unpaid products at the cash register, triggering an audible and light signal to identify the unauthorized theft of a product. An anti-theft system at retail outlets can significantly reduce staff costs, and salespeople can handle customer service.

How does the anti-theft system work in stores?

"RF" technology in anti-theft systems is based on radio frequency, being one of the most commonly used detection technologies worldwide, and flexible and detachable labels are the smallest and most flexible solutions for protecting goods. The low costs of anti-theft systems in stores have helped to spread them, so they are a "must-have" attribute in retail stores.

The flexible and detachable anti-theft labels, glued or fixed on the products, contain an electrical circuit and a small antenna, which response to the signals emitted by anti-theft gates (transmitter mode). The signal (response) emitted by the labels is received by anti-theft gates (receiver module) and is digitally processed. When an anti-theft tag is identified, the anti-theft gates trigger an alarm with an audible and light signal. Modern anti-theft gates are equipped with "digital signal processing" for more advanced differentiation of label signals and external noise.

title: Labeling and registration of samples in Invitro laboratories
description: Currently, medical laboratories are widely and effectively using bar coding-based automation technologies, which significantly improve the quality of service delivery.
content:
Serious requirements are imposed on labeling in laboratories: labels must correspond to the sizes of labeled test tubes, vials, tablets, etc., be readable and understandable in any light, have a long service life, and be resistant to extreme temperatures, and chemical and mechanical damage.

Using the Invitro Diagnostics lab case as an example, we will look at how RTI helps create better label samples. Also, you will find out which labels and printers for labeling samples and specimens are used in histological and cytological laboratories.

Existing problem: Reading handwritten lettering is difficult. In addition, manual labeling is time-consuming. Previously, the laboratory had to write with a felt-tip marker on a very small surface. It is obvious that handwritten labels do not meet the necessary requirements. As a result, laboratory sample management leads to errors that require re-sampling and evaluation, which the patient may not have time for.

Tasks: The main task is to accurately identify the samples under study, as well as send a request for label printing directly from the laboratory database.

Problem-solving: To solve the problems of labeling sample containers, a specialized Citizen CL-S321 printer was supplied, which provides printing that meets the list of the following requirements:

  • The labels must match the size of the tubes, slides, and well plates used.
  • Labels must be legible and understandable to everyone and in any light.
  • Labels must have a long life under harsh conditions, including freezing storage, exposure to liquid nitrogen, autoclaving and hot water baths, and resistance to solvents such as xylene, dimethyl sulfoxide, and ethanol.

The Citizen CL-S321 thermal transfer printer has been integrated into the laboratory's database. Materials available for printing are from 25.4 mm (1 inch) to 118.1 mm (4.6 inches). network and external control devices.

As a result, the printer prints a perfectly clear label! Now there is no risk that the label will be pale, fuzzy, or smeared. Thus, the Invitro Diagnostics laboratory will never have questions about what substance is in the test tube or who produced this sample.

General results of the introduction of barcoding technology:

  • The number of errors decreased, inaccuracies were eliminated when re-identifying a client (for example, an error was eliminated when there are two clients with the same names);
  • The time spent on re-registration of the client was reduced, and as a result, the productivity of the staff increased;
  • The terms of preservation of information for further analysis and processing of h.h. to create and organize loyalty programs for customers based on the collected and processed information;
  • Abuses and losses in storage are eliminated.

Also, for the automation of medical laboratories, RTI offers various types of equipment:

The use of a label printer will be more efficient in conjunction with a barcode reader, allowing the lab to include more information on the label and greatly reducing the possibility of human error.

For stationary and mobile workstations

With lab printers, chemical-resistant labels, and antimicrobial barcode scanners, you can streamline lab management by improving sample identification and traceability from collection to testing.

POS-terminal, fiscal printer and handheld scanner are fixed by a single structure in a vertical position for frontal seating of the cashier. Minimal cashier movements, all equipment is at hand.

3) Build quality and reliability of both technical and software components allow to achieve the best level of performance in the market for current tasks, as well as increased ‘safety margin’ of 10 years.

title: Zorile. Automation of the National Footwear Center
content:
Automating the cashier's (seller's) workplace to organize a convenient and fast process of selling goods.

Main goals:

Automation of settlements with customers;

Accounting of footwear income and expenses: sizes, types, colors, items, withdrawal of sales reports;

Ability to exchange data between retail stores located in different parts of the city;

Result:

The installed equipment provided the cashier with a wide range of trading tools, and the administrator a tool for easy and productive management of the store. Payment area debit has increased. Due to the intuitive and easy-to-use interface of the POS terminal, the training of new cashiers takes approximately 15 minutes. The exclusive software allows you to search and analyze trading operations, as well as generate a report. 100% control of the flow of goods and money in real-time.

title: ТСД для эффективного управления складским комплексом
content: Вопрос выбора терминала сбора данных может предполагать множество нюансов, но покупателя, как правило, в первую очередь интересует цена устройства. Человек, который не является специалистом и не разбирается в технических особенностях оборудования, может счесть любую модель терминала подходящей для выполнения необходимых ему операций. Конечно, каждый терминал сбора данных способен считать штрих кодовую маркировку и передать информацию компьютеру. Однако различные форматы предприятий предполагают уникальные особенности и условия работы, которым необходимы устройства со специфическими характеристиками. Нет сомнений в том, что основной задачей терминала сбора данных является получение информации о поступившем товаре и его отгрузке, формирование заказов и передача всех сведений WMS. Однако остается вопрос, насколько возможности устройства и конфигурация его программного обеспечения совпадают со сложностью работы с товаром на предприятии. А кроме того сопоставимы ли форматы баз данных мобильного оборудования и WMS.
